data.title: EVIDENT Expands Its Pramana Digital Pathology Portfolio to Support Small and Medium-Sized Labs
data.description:
EVIDENT Expands Its Pramana Digital Pathology Portfolio to Support Small and Medium-Sized Labs

EVIDENT Expands Its Pramana Digital Pathology Portfolio to Support Small and Medium-Sized Labs

PR Newswire

NEEDHAM, Mass., Oct. 16, 2026

The new Pramana™ POD benchtop WSI scanner delivers autonomous imaging to help laboratories create pathologist-ready whole slide images with minimal operator intervention.

NEEDHAM, Mass., Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, Evident announced the Pramana™ POD whole slide imaging (WSI) scanner, a new benchtop system designed to help laboratories produce trusted images. Built for small and medium-sized laboratories and specialty applications within larger institutions, the scanner helps make digital pathology adoption more accessible.

As pathology laboratories expand digital workflows amid increasing case volumes and operational demands, they need scanning systems that produce consistent, high-quality images across specimen types while integrating into existing laboratory workflows. Evident designed the Pramana POD scanner to address those needs, extending proven Pramana autonomous WSI technology to smaller laboratories.

"Pramana WSI technology has received tremendous acceptance from pathology labs across academic medical centers and network labs across the United States," said Prasanth Perugupalli, Vice President of Digital Pathology, Evident. "By incorporating quality assurance into the whole slide imaging process, Pramana technology can help labs of varying sizes reduce the need for post-scan QA and the associated costs and delays."

The Pramana POD scanner automates imaging with an advanced tissue finder, extensive label detection, and automated focal plane and scan-profile selection. Built-in image-quality assessment helps deliver pathologist-ready whole slide images and identify scans that may require further review. Volumetric imaging captures multiple focal planes to support the selection of sharp focal information across the scanned area, with true 40X imaging at 25 slides per hour under defined conditions.

The Pramana series of autonomous WSI scanners is well-suited for most brightfield imaging applications, including histopathology, core biopsies, hematology, cytology, and microbiology.

"Scientific advances move quickly, but laboratory infrastructure changes slowly," Perugupalli added. "With the Pramana POD scanner, small and medium-sized labs can build as their needs evolve."

To learn more about the Pramana POD benchtop WSI scanner, visit evidentscientific.com/products/slide-scanners/pramana-pod.

About EVIDENT
For over 100 years as Olympus, we set the industry standard for optical precision in microscopy, helping the world see what was once out of view. Today, as Evident, we continue to help scientists, physicians, and engineers illuminate the unseen with advanced imaging solutions that combine renowned optics with cutting-edge digital innovation.

Our life science portfolio supports research, clinical diagnostics, and education, offering a comprehensive range of imaging methods from essential brightfield and darkfield microscopy to advanced fluorescence, 4D analysis, and digital pathology. In industrial microscopy, we deliver precision and flexibility through laser scanning, digital, and semiconductor microscopes designed for tasks ranging from routine inspection to intricate quality control and manufacturing analysis.

Whether advancing new therapies, ensuring product integrity, or exploring the unknown, Evident is defining a new era of discovery with easy-to-use tools that help unlock hidden answers and empower exciting new breakthroughs.

Evident is headquartered in Tokyo and supported by R&D and manufacturing centers in Japan, the United States, Germany, and China, with operations and dedicated sales and service centers around the world. For more information, visit EvidentScientific.com.

For Research Use Only. Not for use in diagnostic procedures. Future clinical availability is subject to applicable regulatory authorization, and regulatory status and availability may vary by country. Performance varies by specimen type and workflow.
Pramana is a trademark of Evident Corporation or its subsidiaries.

data.title: Eylsia Nicolas's "What Will Become of Me" Reaches #1 on Groover Hip Hop Charts in the U.S.
data.description:
JUPITER, FL / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / Singer‑songwriter Eylsia Nicolas reached a new milestone this week as her latest release, What Will Become of Me, climbed to #1 on the Groover Hip Hop Charts in the United States and entered the Top 40 globally across all genres. The achievement comes just days after Nicolas was rushed for emergency medical treatment, a moment that prompted an outpouring of support from fans around the world.

Nicolas said the messages she received - numbering in the thousands - have been a source of strength.

"What will become of me will turn out fine," she said. "The love and support from people everywhere makes me feel incredibly fortunate. I've had medical reports in the past suggesting I shouldn't be singing, even with technological help, and I pushed my human side too hard. The part of my work that doesn't sleep or tire can put pressure on the part of me that does. But the future isn't a threat - it's only a challenge if we misuse it."

Despite the setback, Nicolas continues to write and release music, supported by a large backlog of unreleased songs. She remains committed to her personal goal of reaching one billion views in 2026 - a benchmark she describes as "not essential, but something I set for myself."

Looking ahead, Nicolas says next year will bring a wide range of creative projects, from music to film to stage productions.

"I've produced on Broadway before, and I expect the coming year to be one of major expansion," she said. "Some of the tools emerging now will surprise people - not in a dramatic way, but in how accessible they make creativity."

Nicolas also announced continued development of HHGC Studios (Human Hybrid Generated Characters), designed for talented individuals who face limitations due to age or injury. The initiative will work alongside her publishing company Bookkards.com, her record label, and her ongoing efforts to recruit young artists.

She emphasized that while she is grateful for the concern shown to her, she hopes attention will remain on those facing more serious circumstances.

"Please save your prayers for the millions of people who are truly struggling," she said. "I'm fortunate to have my fashion lines, the EDTV education network, companion‑AI care projects, and my cosmetic and clothing brands. I was always told health is the most important thing in life - and when you don't have it, it's comforting to have other things to hold onto."

Early Reviews

This Is Hip Hop HQ praised the track's emotional clarity:

"It balances relaxation with motivation. It calms the mind while encouraging belief in oneself. That combination gives the song an uplifting quality that helps listeners pause, reflect, and move forward with renewed determination. A solid 10/10."

Power Ace Radio highlighted the songwriting:

"The lyrics are beautifully crafted and easy to connect with. The chorus is memorable and invites listeners to join in after only a few plays."

LyricalOdyssey noted the song's thematic resonance:

"It deepens the artist's hybrid sound and ties her personal message to her broader musical direction. ‘What Will Become of Me' reminds us that reflection can strengthen our appreciation of life, even when the future feels uncertain."

Eylsia (Lisa Pamintuan) is a Filipina-American singer-songwriter, inventor, entrepreneur, and former international tennis competitor known for innovations in music distribution technology, luxury fashion through Nicolas of Palm Beach, and emerging publishing technology through WorldIPI. data.title: AHF Commemorates 40 Years of Global Impact During Annual World AIDS Day Concert Celebration Featuring Ricky Martin
data.description:
AHF Commemorates 40 Years of Global Impact During Annual World AIDS Day Concert Celebration Featuring Ricky Martin

AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF), the world’s largest, non-profit public health organization providing direct HIV/ADS services to over 3.3 million clients across the globe, will celebrate 40 years of impact during its annual World AIDS Day concert commemoration. Continuing his partnership with AHF, Ricky Martin will headline the free event scheduled for the evening of Monday, November 30, 2026, at the Kia Forum in Inglewood, California.

Martin – a multi-award-winning global star and philanthropist has used his platform to bring greater awareness and support for various issues around HIV/AIDS, human trafficking, and LGBTQIA+ rights. He joined AHF in 2023 to perform to a sold-out crowd as the headliner for the organization’s World AIDS Day concert at the Watsco Center at the University of Miami (UM) in Coral Gables, Florida.

AHF is returning to the Kia Forum to present this year’s commemoration and celebrate its 40th anniversary. AHF held its event at the iconic venue in 2021 when celebrating the organization’s 35th anniversary, which featured Christina Aguliera and Jennifer Hudson.

Commemorated annually on December 1st, World AIDS Day is an international observance held to raise awareness of the HIV/AIDS epidemic, show support for people living with HIV, and remember those who have died from AIDS-related illnesses. Since, 2016, AHF’s World AIDS Day commemoration, under the slogan of Keep the Promise, has been presented in cities across the country, including Dallas, Atlanta, New York, Washington, D.C. and Houston. To heighten broader public awareness to the on-going impact of the global epidemic, and the work still to be done, the organization has previously worked with acclaimed director/choreographer, Debbie Allen to produce the show and over the last decade, partnered with a diverse array of performing artists such as Mariah Carey, Common, Janet Jackson, Patti LaBelle, Jennifer Holliday, Diana Ross and Gladys Knight to perform at the annual event.

According to recent statistics from U.N. AIDS, there are over 41 million individuals living with HIV and 1.2 million have been newly diagnosed. Domestically, approximately 1.2 million people live with HIV in the U.S., and about 13% of them do not know they have it, according to HIV.gov.

Founded in 1987, AIDS Healthcare Foundation started as a network of hospices and grassroots advocacy in Los Angeles. It was originally known as the AIDS Hospice Foundation before changing its name to the AIDS Healthcare Foundation in 1990. To date, AHF has healthcare and wellness centers in 50 countries and 19 domestic locations including the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico. AHF provides direct HIV/AIDS services to over 3.2 million individuals in care.

The organization will announce other program participants, including local Los Angeles based non-profit organizations receiving funding support for HIV/AIDS prevention and treatment services. To learn more about AHF and the 2026 World AIDS Day event, visit ahf.org. To register for complimentary tickets go to: ahfwad.org

AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF), the world’s largest HIV/AIDS healthcare organization, provides cutting-edge medicine and advocacy to more than 3.2 million individuals across 50 countries, including the U.S. and in Africa, Latin America/Caribbean, the Asia/Pacific Region, and Eastern Europe. In January 2025, AHF received the MLK, Jr. Social Justice Award, The King Center’s highest recognition for an organization leading work in the social justice arena. To learn more about AHF, visit us online at AIDShealth.org, find us on Facebook, and follow us on Instagram, Twitter, and TikTok.

Located in Inglewood, California, the Kia Forum is the only arena-sized venue in the country dedicated to music and entertainment, delivering a superior experience for artists and fans alike. The iconic venue hosts a diverse range of premier events, featuring the biggest names in music and entertainment, award shows, combat sports, and more. Fans at the Kia Forum enjoy approximately 8,000 square feet of event-level hospitality offerings, including merchandise and food and beverage options. A tinted glass wall separates this concession area from the arena, ensuring fans do not miss a moment of the show. A 40,000-square-foot outdoor terrace wraps around the perimeter of the building and offers comfortable furnishings and food and beverage options from some of SoCal’s most celebrated brands. Designed with entertainers and performers in mind, Kia Forum Backstage includes star-caliber dressing rooms that provide unparalleled comfort. The Kia Forum received Pollstar's "Arena of the Decade" award in 2022 and was named the top West Coast arena in 2025 by Pollstar and Billboard magazines. thekiaforum.com | Instagram | Facebook | Twitter

data.title: Blaize Holdings, Inc. Announces Distribution of Series B Preferred Stock to Holders of its Common Stock Intended to Facilitate a Reverse Stock Split, if Necessary
data.description:
SAN JOSE, Calif., Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Blaize Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BZAI, NASDAQ: BZAIW) (“Blaize,” the “Company,” “we,” “us,” and “our”), a leader in programmable, energy-efficient AI computing, announced today that its Board of Directors declared a dividend of one one-thousandth of a share of newly designated Series B Preferred Stock, par value $0.0001 per share, for each outstanding share of Blaize common stock held of record on October 26, 2026. The outstanding shares of Series B Preferred Stock will vote together with the outstanding shares of the Company’s common stock as a single class exclusively with respect to any proposal to adopt an amendment to the Company’s certificate of incorporation to reclassify the outstanding shares of the Company’s common stock into a smaller number of shares of such common stock at a ratio specified in or determined in accordance with the terms of any such amendment (a “Reverse Stock Split Proposal”), as well as any proposal to adjourn any meeting of stockholders called for the purpose of voting on the foregoing matter (an “Adjournment Proposal”), and will not be entitled to vote on any other matter, except to the extent required under the Delaware General Corporation Law. Subject to certain limitations, each outstanding share of Series B Preferred Stock will have 1,000,000 votes per share (or 1,000 votes per one one-thousandth of a share of Series B Preferred Stock).

All shares of Series B Preferred Stock that are not present in person or by proxy at any meeting of stockholders held to vote on the above described amendment proposal as of immediately prior to the opening of the polls at such meeting will automatically be redeemed by the Company. Any outstanding shares of Series B Preferred Stock that have not been so redeemed will automatically be redeemed in whole, but not in part, at the close of business on the earlier of (i) the business day established by the Company’s Board of Directors in its sole discretion and (ii) the first business day following the date on which the Company’s stockholders approve an amendment to the Company’s certificate of incorporation to reclassify the outstanding shares of the Company’s common stock into a smaller number of shares of such common stock at a ratio specified in or determined in accordance with the terms of any such amendment.

The Company’s Board of Directors has adopted resolutions providing that the Series B Preferred Stock will be uncertificated. The certificate of designation governing Series B Preferred Stock will provide that shares of Series B Preferred Stock may not be transferred except in connection with a transfer by such holder of any shares of the Company’s common stock held by such holder. In that case, a number of one one-thousandths of a share of Series B Preferred Stock equal to the number of shares of the Company’s common stock to be transferred by such holder will be transferred to the transferee of such shares of common stock.

Further details regarding the Series B Preferred Stock will be contained in a report on Form 8-K to be filed by Blaize with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

About Blaize Holdings, Inc.

Blaize delivers a programmable AI platform, purpose-built for AI inference workloads in real-world environments. Its Hybrid AI architecture combines the Blaize GSP (Graph Streaming Processor) with GPU-based infrastructure, enabling AI inference workloads to run across edge, cloud, and data center. Blaize solutions support computer vision, multimodal AI, and sensor-driven applications across smart cities, industrial automation, telecommunications, retail, logistics, and mission-critical operations. Blaize is headquartered in San Jose, California, with a presence across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Visit www.blaize.com or follow us on LinkedIn @blaizeinc.

Forward-looking statements are based on management’s current expectations and are subject to risks, uncertainties and changes in circumstances, many of which are outside the Company’s control. Robbins LLP Urges Investors Who Lost Money Investing in Qfin Holdings, Inc. to Contact the Firm for Information About Their Rights Against QFIN

Shareholder rights law firm Robbins LLP reminds investors that a class action was filed on behalf of persons and entities who purchased or otherwise acquired Qfin Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: QFIN) securities between March 18, 2026 and August 25, 2026, inclusive (the "Class Period"). Qfin, together with its subsidiaries, operates a purported artificial intelligence-(“AI”) driven credit technology platform under the “Qifu Jietiao” brand in the People’s Republic of China (“China” or the “PRC”).

The complaint alleges that Qfin Holdings, Inc. misled investors regarding the impact of the new PRC regulatory guidance on its business prospects.

Investors who suffered significant losses during the Class Period may be eligible to participate in the lawsuit and should contact Robbins LLP for more information before the November 30, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline.

Why Was Qfin Sued?

According to the complaint, during the Class Period, defendants touted Qfin's ability to weather, adapt, and thrive in response to the recent and emerging PRC regulations affecting its business. For example, at all relevant times, defendants characterized Qfin’s business as, inter alia, “resilient”, “steady”, and “stable” in the face of these regulations, while touting the Company’s purportedly “proactive” strategies and policies designed to improve, and which were purportedly already improving, Qfin’s risk performance and other operational metrics.

Specifically, defendants failed to disclose that:

  1. defendants had overstated the resiliency and stability of Qfin’s business and financial results despite regulatory changes;
  2. defendants likewise downplayed the true scope and severity of the negative impact that regulatory headwinds were likely to have, and were already having, on the Company’s business and financial results; and
  3. as a result, defendants’ public statements were materially false and misleading at all relevant times.

Why Did Qfin Stock Drop?

Plaintiff alleges that on August 25, 2026, Qfin announced its second quarter (“Q2”) and interim 2026 unaudited financial results. The Company reported, inter alia, that total net revenue fell 31.6% year-over-year (“Y/Y”) from approximately RMB 5.22 billion to approximately RMB 3.57 billion, significantly missing consensus estimates. In addition, net income plummeted 76.8% Y/Y from approximately RMB 1.73 billion to RMB 401.4 million, heavily impacted by an unexpected RMB 500 million tax expense “caused by a change in tax treatment of certain entities based on the updated interpretation of related tax regulations by the tax authorities.” Management also issued disappointing forward financial guidance, projecting a 67% to 73% Y/Y decrease in third quarter (“Q3”) non-GAAP2 net income due to rising funding costs and systemic liquidity shocks in the Chinese consumer credit market.

In discussing these disappointing results, Qfin's CEO cited, inter alia, “a challenging market environment marked by continued industry contraction, tighter regulatory oversight, and a sudden industry-wide liquidity shock in late June”, warning that, “[l]ooking ahead, we expect industry adjustments to continue, with funding conditions and risk management likely to remain under pressure.” On this news, Qfin’s American depositary share (“ADS”) price fell $2.18 per ADS, or 18.91%, to close at $9.35 per ADS on August 26, 2026.

Listen to Our Podcast

Who May Be Eligible to Participate in the Qfin Class Action?

The lawsuit seeks to represent investors who purchased or otherwise acquired Qfin Holdings, Inc. securities between March 18, 2026 and August 25, 2026. Investors who suffered losses during that period may have legal rights under the federal securities laws.

What Is a Lead Plaintiff?

The lead plaintiff is a court-appointed investor who represents the interests of all class members throughout the litigation. Investors who wish to lead the class action should contact Robbins LLP before November 30, 2026.

Serving as lead plaintiff is not required to share in any potential recovery. Investors who do not seek appointment may remain absent class members if the case proceeds and later resolves successfully.

Does It Cost Anything to Participate?

No. Robbins LLP represents investors on a contingency fee basis.

Why Robbins LLP?

A recognized leader in shareholder rights litigation, Robbins LLP represents investors in securities fraud and shareholder derivative litigation. We have helped restore more than $2 billion in value to shareholders and secured some of the largest recoveries in shareholder derivative litigation history.

"Companies have an obligation to provide investors with complete and accurate information so that markets can function fairly and efficiently," said Brian J. Robbins, Founding Partner of Robbins LLP.

data.title: Labaton Keller Sucharow LLP Files Securities Class Action Against Bank of America Corporation and Certain of Its Executives
data.description:
Labaton Keller Sucharow LLP Files Securities Class Action Against Bank of America Corporation and Certain of Its Executives

Labaton Keller Sucharow LLP (“Labaton”) has filed a securities class action lawsuit (the “Action”) on behalf of its client the New England Teamsters Pension Fund (“New England Teamsters”) against Bank of America Corporation (“Bank of America” or the “Company”) (NYSE: BAC) and certain of its executives (collectively, “Defendants”). The Action, which is captioned New England Teamsters Pension Fund v. Bank of America Corporation., No. 26-cv-09137 (S.D.N.Y.), asserts claims under Sections 10(b) and 20(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission Rule 10b-5 promulgated thereunder on behalf of all persons and entities that purchased or otherwise acquired Bank of America common stock between August 1, 2025 and October 13, 2026, inclusive (the “Class Period”).

Bank of America is a multinational bank holding company that conducts most of its banking business through its wholly owned subsidiary, Bank of America, N.A. (“BANA”). On December 23, 2024, the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (“OCC”), an agency of the U.S. Department of the Treasury, issued a cease-and-desist order against BANA requiring comprehensive corrective actions to address deficiencies in its Bank Secrecy Act/anti-money laundering (“BSA/AML”) and sanctions compliance programs (the “2024 Consent Order”). During the Class Period, the Company represented that the 2024 Consent Order related to only “certain aspects” of its compliance programs, that it had “already completed significant steps” to satisfy the order’s requirements, and that the compliance issues would not have a “material adverse financial impact” on the Company.

The Action alleges that, throughout the Class Period, Defendants knew or recklessly disregarded, but failed to disclose, that: (i) systemic weaknesses in BANA’s BSA/AML program caused it to fail to properly monitor trillions of dollars in transactions and to miss, delay, or file inaccurate or incomplete suspicious activity reports involving billions of dollars in suspicious activity; (ii) internal reports had documented BANA’s BSA/AML deficiencies for years, yet BANA had not adequately remedied them after the 2024 Consent Order; (iii) BANA also had deficiencies in its sanctions compliance program and processed transactions later identified as apparent violations of multiple sanctions programs; and (iv) fixing these deficiencies required significant additional compliance resources and exposed BANA to substantial penalties and costs. These facts rendered Defendants’ statements about the scope of BANA’s compliance failures, its progress under the 2024 Consent Order, and the expected costs and penalties materially false and misleading.

The truth began to emerge after the market closed on October 13, 2026, when the U.S. Department of Treasury announced coordinated enforcement actions against BANA resulting in more than $1.21 billion in penalties and settlements. The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (“FinCEN”) assessed a $1.2 billion penalty, including credit for a $750 million penalty imposed by the OCC, and the Office of Foreign Assets Control (“OFAC”) separately announced an $11.6 million settlement. In its order, FinCEN stated that BANA admitted that it willfully violated the BSA and missed or delayed detecting and reporting more than $5 billion in suspicious activity. The OCC further found that, despite the 2024 Consent Order, BANA had failed to complete significant corrective steps and its BSA/AML program remained deficient. The truth continued to emerge the following morning, October 14, 2026, when Bank of America reported its third quarter 2026 results, showing that the regulatory settlement charge reduced diluted earnings per share by $0.17. Following the enforcement announcements and quarterly results, Bank of America’s stock price fell to an intraday low of $49.26 on October 14, 2026, before closing at $51.39, down 4.8% from the previous day’s closing price of $53.96.

If you purchased or otherwise acquired Bank of America common stock during the Class Period and suffered losses as a result, you may be a member of the proposed “Class” and eligible to seek appointment as Lead Plaintiff. Lead Plaintiff motion papers must be filed no later than December 15, 2026. The Lead Plaintiff is a court-appointed representative for absent members of the Class. You do not need to seek appointment as Lead Plaintiff to share in any Class recovery in this action. If you are a Class member and there is a recovery for the Class, you can share in that recovery as an absent Class member. You may retain counsel of your choice to represent you in this action.

data.title: Science and Medicine Group (SMG) Names Jasen Holness Senior Vice President, Sales and Marketing to Accelerate Customer Growth
data.description:
ARLINGTON, VA / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / Science and Medicine Group ( SMG ), a market research and digital marketing company serving the life science, diagnostics, analytical instruments, and medical imaging industries, today announced Jasen Holness as Senior Vice President, Sales and Marketing. Holness joined SMG on September 28 and oversees sales and marketing across the company's market research and insights brands and its digital media brands, reporting to Chief Executive Officer Tony LePage.

Holness's appointment supports SMG's work to unify its family of brands into a more connected experience for customers, a priority the company outlined when it named Tony LePage Chief Executive Officer . It also reflects SMG's continued investment in the people, data, and technology behind its intelligence, and in new ways for customers to engage with it.

"SMG's primary, syndicated, and proprietary intelligence is a rare combination. My focus is helping customers get the most from that intersection, turning insight into actionable strategy that delivers real return on investment. I'm excited to bring an energized, dynamic, and connected experience to our customers and strategic partners as we accelerate the unification of our brands and portfolio," said Holness.

Holness brings more than 25 years of consumer and B2B market research and commercial leadership experience to SMG. He most recently served as Executive Vice President, Commercial and Key Account Strategy, North America at Toluna | MetrixLab, and previously as Senior Vice President, Agency and Media Practice at MetrixLab. Holness led the integration of the Toluna, MetrixLab, and Gutcheck commercial teams into a high-performing sales organization and established multi-year strategic partnerships with leading technology, social media, and financial services companies.

"Jasen pairs deep market research expertise with a proven record of building sales teams and strategic partnerships that drive lasting client growth," said LePage. "As we bring our brands closer together, Jasen will help ensure customers experience SMG as one connected partner, with a faster, more intuitive path from insight to action."

In his role, Holness will focus on helping customers get more from the intersection of SMG's primary, syndicated, and proprietary intelligence platforms, delivering strategic, actionable insights that steer decisions and deliver measurable return on investment.

About Science and Medicine Group (SMG)

Since 1994, Science and Medicine Group (SMG) has been a life science market research and digital marketing company serving the life science, diagnostics, analytical instruments, and medical imaging industries. SMG delivers qualitative and quantitative market research, including syndicated reports, custom research, and market data, through respected brands such as Kalorama Information , SDi , IMV , and BioInformatics , backed by direct access to a proprietary network of more than 55,000 vetted scientific and clinical experts. SMG also connects clients with hard-to-reach healthcare professionals through AuntMinnie , AuntMinnie Europe , and DrBicuspid. SMG's mission is to empower the organizations and people advancing human health by delivering the insights, data, and audiences they need to accelerate decision making with confidence. Learn more at scienceandmedicinegroup.com.

Science and Medicine Group

data.title: /C O R R E C T I O N - PepsiCo Beverages North America/
data.description:
/C O R R E C T I O N - PepsiCo Beverages North America/

/C O R R E C T I O N - PepsiCo Beverages North America/

PR Newswire

PURCHASE, N.Y., Oct. 15, 2026

In the news release, PEPSI® AND OFF SEASON GIVE GREAT TASTE A ONE-OF-A-KIND TAILGATE FIT WITH MINI NFL PUFFER CAN JACKETS, issued 15-Oct-2026 by PepsiCo Beverages North America over PR Newswire, we are advised by the company that changes have been made. The complete, corrected release follows, with additional details at the end:

PEPSI® AND OFF SEASON GIVE GREAT TASTE A ONE-OF-A-KIND TAILGATE FIT WITH MINI NFL PUFFER CAN JACKETS

Fan-favorite Off Season shrinks its viral NFL puffer down to fit 12-ounce Pepsi cans, pairing ice-cold Pepsi with official team style across all 15 NFL team partners

  • Off Season reimagines its signature NFL puffer as a functional can jacket designed to keep Pepsi cold and hands comfortable from the tailgate to the stadium to the backyard watch party.
  • Fifteen collectible styles feature official NFL team colors and logos, working zippers and sleeves, and custom patches inspired by signature Off Season outerwear.
  • Fans can score puffer can jackets through a national sweepstakes.

PURCHASE, N.Y., Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- If PEPSI® is your gameday drink, you already have great taste. And great taste deserves great gameday style. Starting today, Pepsi is teaming up with Off Season, the beloved sports-fashion brand founded by Kristin Juszczyk and Emma Grede, to give Pepsi cans a gameday fit of their own.

For the first Pepsi x Off Season collaboration, the brand behind the viral NFL puffer shrunk its signature jacket down to fit a 12-ounce Pepsi can. The result is a miniature puffer can jacket that keeps Pepsi cold, hands comfortable and team pride on display, whether fans are at the tailgate, inside the stadium or gathering at home.

The collaboration is the latest chapter of Tailgating Deserves Pepsi, the season-long platform built around the fact that gameday food tastes better with the bold taste of Pepsi.

THE MAIN EVENT: MINI NFL PUFFER CAN JACKETS
The puffer can jackets feature official NFL team colors and logos, working zippers and sleeves, and custom patches inspired by signature Off Season outerwear. The 15 styles celebrate each Pepsi NFL team partner: the Buffalo Bills, Cincinnati Bengals, Dallas Cowboys, Los Angeles Chargers, Los Angeles Rams, Miami Dolphins, Minnesota Vikings, New England Patriots, New York Giants, New York Jets, Philadelphia Eagles, Pittsburgh Steelers, San Francisco 49ers, Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Washington Commanders.

Fans can enter the Pepsi x Off Season Can Jacket Sweepstakes now through November 30 for a chance to receive a complimentary puffer can jacket. See the official rules here: offseasonpepsisweeps.com.

"The puffer jacket is where Off Season began, and I had this idea to take our signature design and turn it into something completely unexpected," said Kristin Juszczyk, Founder and Chief Creative Officer of Off Season. "I enjoy a Pepsi at every game, so getting to partner with the brand to bring my vision to life was a perfect match. After all, there's no better-tasting beverage to fill our miniature puffer can jackets. I can't wait for fans to get their hands on them."

"Pepsi has always been at the center of gameday, from the food fans enjoy to the teams they rally behind," said Gustavo Reyna, Vice President of Marketing, Pepsi. "With Off Season, we're turning the Pepsi can in your hand into part of your gameday fit – bringing together great taste, team pride and one of football's most recognizable fashion statements in a way only Pepsi can."

As the Official Soft Drink of the NFL and a partner of 15 NFL teams, Pepsi has a distinct place within the food, fandom and traditions that define football season. Pepsi x Off Season gives fans a new way to bring that team pride to the Pepsi in their hand.

About PepsiCo
PepsiCo products are enjoyed by consumers more than one billion times a day in more than 200 countries and territories around the world. PepsiCo generated nearly $94 billion in net revenue in 2025, driven by a complementary beverage and convenient foods portfolio that includes Lay's, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker, and SodaStream. PepsiCo's product portfolio includes a wide range of enjoyable foods and drinks, including many iconic brands that generate more than $1 billion each in estimated annual retail sales.

Guiding PepsiCo is our vision to be the Global Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with pep+ (PepsiCo Positive). pep+ is our strategic end-to-end transformation that places sustainability at the center of our business strategy, seeking to drive growth and build a stronger, more resilient future for PepsiCo and the communities where we operate. For more information, visit www.pepsico.com, and follow on X (Twitter), Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @PepsiCo.

About Off Season
Off Season, co-founded by designer Kristin Juszczyk and entrepreneur Emma Grede, is redefining traditional fan gear by merging fashion and design with elevated team apparel that goes beyond the stadium and tailgate. Launched in January 2025, the brand brings Kristin's signature approach to custom fan apparel, embraced by athletes, celebrities and fans alike, together with Emma's entrepreneurial expertise to reimagine what sports apparel can look like.

Correction: An earlier version of this release required an update to the third bullet and the removal of a paragraph.

data.title: XCF Global CEO Updates Shareholders Following Recent Market Volatility
data.description:
HOUSTON, TX / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / XCF Global, Inc. (NASDAQ:SAFX) today shared the following update with shareholders:

"We understand that the recent volatility and decline in our share price have been concerning and frustrating for our shareholders, and we take those concerns seriously. We value the confidence our shareholders have placed in XCF and believe it is important to communicate openly about the progress we are making and the priorities that continue to guide us.

Although short-term market movements are outside our control, we remain firmly focused on what we can control: executing our strategy, managing our resources responsibly, strengthening our business, and creating sustainable long-term value for our shareholders.

Over the past several months, we believe XCF has made meaningful progress in transitioning our Reno facility from development and commissioning to commercial operations. We reported more than $10 million in revenue for August and over $12 million in gross product sales (a non-GAAP financial measure) for September, with daily production reaching approximately 85,000 gallons by the end of September. These milestones reflect tangible progress in building our business and the dedication of our team. We believe this progress positions XCF to respond to continued growth in demand for renewable fuels, supported by the expansion of low-carbon fuel programs across a growing number of states.

Today, we also announced the closing of our business combination with Southern Energy Renewables and DevvStream, as we work toward advancing our broader strategy to build a diversified energy platform.

We recognize that operational progress must ultimately translate into sustainable profitability, greater financial strength, and long-term shareholder value. Our management team and Board remain focused on these priorities, including disciplined capital allocation, responsible management of our capital structure, and protection of our shareholders' long-term interests.

We know that shareholder confidence is earned through execution, transparency, and results. We are holding ourselves to that standard and intend to demonstrate our progress through measurable operating performance and clear, consistent communication.

On behalf of our management team and Board of Directors, I thank our shareholders for their continued engagement and support. We remain focused on building a stronger XCF and creating long-term value for those who have invested in our future. Our responsibility is not simply to grow the business, but to ensure that the value created by that growth benefits our shareholders over the long term."

Chris Cooper
Chief Executive Officer
XCF Global, Inc.

About XCF Global, Inc.
XCF Global, Inc. is a U.S.-based producer of renewable diesel and SAF focused on decarbonizing transportation while supporting domestic fuel supply, energy security and alternative uses for agricultural waste products. Its New Rise Renewables Reno facility has permitted nameplate capacity of 38 - 40 million gallons per year. XCF trades on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol SAFX. To learn more, visit xcf.global.

Non-GAAP Measures Definitions & Reconciliations

This press release contains non-GAAP (accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America) financial measures as defined by SEC Regulation G and indicated in the text of this release. However, these non-GAAP measures are not measures of financial performance under U.S. GAAP and should not be considered as an alternative to revenue or net income (loss) or any other measure of performance derived in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

Because not all companies use identical definitions or calculations, our presentation of these measures may not be comparable to similarly titled measures of other companies. In reliance upon Item 10(e)(1)(i)(B) of Regulation S-K, reconciliations of forward-looking GAAP and non-GAAP measures are not provided because of the unreasonable effort associated with providing such reconciliations due to the variability in the occurrence and the amounts of certain components of GAAP and non-GAAP measures. For the same reasons, we are unable to address the significance of the unavailable information, which could be material to future results.

Gross product sales is a management estimate of the dollar value of the finished renewable fuel product sales in the end-customer markets. XCF believes that this is an important and relevant metric regarding the sales value of the company's products when comparing XCF to other companies. Management defines this as the number of gallons of renewable fuel sold by the Company during a period multiplied by the average observed or derived price in the end-customer market for each product during a period, including government incentives, feedstock, processing and logistics.
